title: MCP report tool
description: Input and output of the `report` MCP tool (design/reports.md): the baseline report of PROP-0010 B8, computed by code from recorded data only (the board, the approval queue, the resource ledger, the event log, and the decisions they name) over a period and one project or every one. The root describes one call (tool, input, structured output); a provider validates input and output against `#/$defs/report-input` and `#/$defs/report-output`. 1.1 adds what a cap counts as 0; 1.2 adds `attention.liveness`, the agent runs whose liveness asked for the operator. 1.3 adds `attention.reviewsHeld`, the reviews held for the operator and when each expires. 1.4 adds `usage.draws`, the quota agent runs drew per kind, template step, and window. 1.5 adds `advice`, the dispatch advisor in shadow and the Brier score of each question it answers (PROP-0015 J1). 1.6 adds the `metrics` tool's input and output (`#/$defs/metrics-input`, `#/$defs/metrics-output`: the maturity metrics of PROP-0016 §1 and the L3 reading) and the report's `maturity`, the same over the 30 days to its end.

taskStates.description: Tasks per state, as the board holds them when the report reads it (`asOf`).

usage.description: Counted usage records and what they consumed: tokens as the ledger counts them (input includes cached input), turns, and the runtime's own cost estimate; and, from 1.1, what a cap counts as 0.

withoutTokens.description: Counted records that carry no token counts: a tokens cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

withoutCost.description: Counted records that carry no cost: a usd cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

withoutTurns.description: Counted records that carry no turn count: a turns cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

unknownRuns.description: Runs recorded in the period whose usage the ledger could not count (`usage.unknown`) and has not counted a record of since (its own lower bound never counts as one): a figure counts at most that lower bound, and a cap of their task or project in their pool is refused (1.1; ADR-0065). Absent: none.

points.description: Percentage points of a window's allowance.

drawFigure.description: One group of quota draws (1.4): its kind of work (absent: runs admitted for none), with `byStep` its template and step, its window, the clean draws counted, their median and 90th percentile (nearest rank) in percentage points (absent with none), and the entries left out of the figures by state.

projectId.description: One project; absent: every project on the board (the studio).

since.description: The period's start (inclusive). With neither since nor days, the period is the 7 days before until.

until.description: The period's end (exclusive); default the time of the call.

days.description: The period as the days before until; not with since.

period.description: The period counted: from since (inclusive) to until (exclusive), at most 366 days.

projectId.description: The project reported on; absent: every project.

asOf.description: When the board and the queue were read: the `now` counts are as of then, whatever the period.

projects.description: The projects reported on, by id: each one's state, charter, milestones, and tasks now.

attention.description: The charter's attention budget, when it sets one.

projectsOmitted.description: Projects counted but not listed, past the first 100 by id.

done.description: Tasks whose accepting acceptance decision was made in the period: the accepted results.

doneByOperator.description: Of those, accepted by the operator's own decision (a review held for the operator).

attempts.description: Runs whose outcome reached their task in the period (`workflow.task.reported`), one per attempt.

accepted.description: Accepted by the run's own acceptance decision: the task done.

rejected.description: Rejected by a check the run ran itself: another attempt, without the operator.

heldForOperator.description: Held for the operator's acceptance: a required check not reported.

reconciled.description: Reported with reconcileRun and neither accepted nor held: a failed or stopped run, or one whose holder was lost.

other.description: Refused, moved on, or never started.

review.description: The exact-subject review the run's acceptance decision reports, by attempt: passed (approved), failed (changes still requested), or none bound to the result.

remediation.description: Remediation of blocking review findings in the period: cycles grown, and fixes the approval queue opened or closed.

approved.description: Approved by the operator in the period.

rejected.description: Rejected by the operator's verdict in the period.

withdrawn.description: Withdrawn in the period: the waiting work ended first, or the policy changed.

openNow.description: Open or batched as of asOf.

wait.description: From a request's creation to the operator's verdict, over the verdicts given in the period; nearest-rank percentiles. Absent with no verdict.

attention.description: What asked for the operator in the period: approval requests made and reviews held for the operator (interruptions), and the batches shown (a batch the queue made, or a request answered alone), per UTC day.

days.description: The days with any interruption or batch, in order.

over.description: Set when the day is over the project's charter thresholds.

threshold.description: The project's charter attention budget, for a report on one project that sets one.

daysOver.description: Days over the threshold, with one.

liveness.description: 1.2: the agent runs whose liveness asked for the operator in the period (PROP-0013), only when there is any: stalls reported (`agent-workers.run.stalled`), runs that ended without being known to be gone, their session and worktree held until the operator frees them (`agent-workers.run.unknown`), and runs the operator freed (`agent-workers.run.freed`); `held`, those that ended unknown in the period and were not freed in it, the latest first. Not counted as interruptions.

heldOmitted.description: Held runs counted but not listed, past the latest 64.

reviewsHeld.description: 1.3: the board tasks whose review is held for the operator as the report is made (`operator-review`), the soonest to expire first, only when there is any: each expires unseen at `expiresAt`, and its task then waits for input (`review-expired`).

pendingChecks.description: The class's required checks the acceptance did not report passed, as the task's `waiting.pendingChecks` names them.

reviewsHeldOmitted.description: 1.3: held reviews counted but not listed, past the first 64.

usage.description: The ledger's counted usage records observed in the period (for one project: those naming it or one of its tasks, or the run or execution that served one of its tasks).

unknown.description: The runs recorded in the period whose usage the ledger could not count (`usage-unknown@1.0`), each once by the kind of its first entry, and how many of them it has counted a record of since (reconciled). Absent: none (1.1).

draws.description: 1.4: what agent runs ended in the period drew from their accounts' windows (`quota-draw@1.0`, PROP-0015 E2), per kind and window and per kind, template step, and window: the clean draws counted, their median and 90th percentile in percentage points, and the entries left out by why. Absent: none recorded.

omitted.description: Figures counted but not listed, past the first 256 of either list.

digests.description: Digests of task results that ended in the period: attached to the task, or bypassed (failing open); and, for those attached, the claims kept and dropped and the escalations, when a digest provider is loaded to read them.

baseline.description: PROP-0008's baseline: accepted results, what asked for the operator, and, with at least one accepted result, what each cost.

advice.description: 1.5: the dispatch advisor in shadow (PROP-0015 J1) over the period, present only when a choice was advised or a dispatched attempt's outcome recorded: choices advised and not, outcomes recorded and how many of them were advised, and one Brier score per question over the chosen candidate's probabilities, beside the score of always answering the observed rate.

shadowAttempts.description: D74: dispatched attempts with outcomes the advice runs in shadow for.

maturity.description: 1.6: the maturity metrics over the 30 days to the period's end, and the reading against the L3 lines (PROP-0016 I4), as the `metrics` tool gives them. Absent when they could not be read; a note says why.

notes.description: What the report could not count, and why (an event log trimmed before the period, no digest provider loaded).

metric.description: One metric over the window (1.6): its value, the sample it is over, and the records it read; or, not measurable, why, and no value (never 0). A value the records only bound says which bound, and why.

figures.description: Other figures of the same reading, by name (a 90th percentile, the parts of a sum).

bound.description: The value is a lower or an upper bound: the records miss some of what it counts.

reason.description: Why it cannot be measured; or, measured, why its value is a bound and what it leaves out.

byKind.description: Cost per accepted result only: its usage and the quota its agent runs drew, by kind of work, each over the accepted results. A kind absent is not known (a usage record no quota draw names a kind for, or a run admitted for none); a window draw that is not clean is counted by state, its quota not known. A component none of the kind's records carries (tokens, cost, turns), or a window's points with no clean draw, is absent: not known, never 0.

l3.description: PROP-0016's L3 line for the metric (a starting line, D83), and where the value stands: meets or misses it, unproven (a bound on the side that does not settle it), or not read (no value).

metrics-input.description: 1.6: the `metrics` tool's input: one project or every one, and the window as the days before until (default 30).

projectId.description: One project; absent: every project on the board.

days.description: The window as the days before until; default 30, the window a level is read over.

until.description: The window's end (exclusive); default the time of the call.

metrics-output.description: 1.6: the `metrics` tool's output (docs/design/maturity-metrics.md): every metric of PROP-0016 §1, in its table's order, and the reading against the L3 lines.

asOf.description: When the board and the queue were read: the `metrics` tool gives it; a report's `maturity` does not, its report's `asOf` says it.

level.description: The reading against the L3 lines: holds only when every line is met, over at least 30 days and 30 finished tasks; otherwise not shown, with each reason. A reading, never a switch.

poolUsage.description: One pool's counted usage, and what a cap counts as 0.

withoutTokens.description: Counted records that carry no token counts: a tokens cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

withoutCost.description: Counted records that carry no cost: a usd cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

withoutTurns.description: Counted records that carry no turn count: a turns cap counts them as 0. Absent: none.

unknownRuns.description: Runs recorded in the period whose usage the ledger could not count (`usage.unknown`) and has not counted a record of since (its own lower bound never counts as one): a figure counts at most that lower bound, and a cap of their task or project in their pool is refused (1.1; ADR-0065). Absent: none.

lead-digest-input.description: 1.7: the `lead_digest` tool's input: the project (a lead token's own by default) and the UTC day (default today). Its output is the `lead-digest@1.0` record.

lead-health-input.description: 1.7: the `lead_health` tool's input: the project (a lead token's own by default).

lead-health-output.description: 1.7, 1.8: the `lead_health` tool's output (PROP-0019 section 2.10): one row per source, each ok, degraded, failed, or unknown with its reason; a source that could not be read is unknown, never ok (INV-2). `failed` (1.8, T345) is the disk row under its floor. `state` is failed when any row is, else degraded when any is, else unknown when any is, else ok.
